dos: Talk to one viewer. Say 'you', ask one question, show your face, end with one ask.
Keep the product and the caption on one topic.
Add your voice. A story and a question make the viewer feel they know you.
Shoot it bright and sharp with your face in frame; dark footage is the surest way to lose the viewer.
Keep saying 'we'; the viewer should feel like you.
donts: Don't let 8–20 s sit still; one cut or a second reveal there.
Don't end without an ask: save it, try it, tell me.
